name: What is the difference between air fresheners and professional odor removal?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between air fresheners and professional odor removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Air fresheners and DIY deodorizers merely mask smoke odors by releasing fragrances, offering a temporary solution. They do not eliminate the embedded microscopic smoke particles that are the source of the smell. Professional odor removal, in contrast, uses scientific methods and industrial-grade equipment, such as ozone generators or hydroxyl technology, to chemically neutralize or physically remove these odor-causing particles from materials and the air. This results in a permanent and thorough elimination of the smoke smell.
acceptedAnswer.description: Air fresheners mask odors, while professional services neutralize or remove smoke particles chemically or physically for a permanent solution.
